physicalEvidence.summary: SafeGen-LLM (February 2026) post-trains LLM task planners with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO guided by formal reward machines. Its full section V-G executes a generated block-stacking sequence on an actual Elephant myCobot 280 through Raspberry Pi/SSH. The physical case compares a safety-aware action order with an unsafe baseline that collides. This is learned high-level task sequencing with ordinary execution primitives, not a learned continuous motor policy or a broad real-world success benchmark. Most reported quantitative results are symbolic planning tasks; no repeated hardware trial count is established. This is collaborative Notre Dame-led hardware with Kong’s current doctoral student; present WSU Tri-Cities learned hardware is not established. The separate local 2026 quadruped abstract is simulation-based, while a rescue-VLA award describes a research direction, not completed deployment.
